title: Aquatic Park Sailing Club

services.name: Fleet Program
services.desc: Don't own a boat? The fleet program gives you access to APSC's two Tanzer 22 sailboats. Book half-day or evening slots and sail Toronto Harbour and the islands. It's a great option for people who want to keep sailing without the commitment of ownership. Spouse/partner can be included. No voting

blurb: Aquatic Park Sailing Club is nestled in Tommy Thompson Park, an "Urban Wilderness" on the Leslie Spit. We are surrounded by nature with swans and beavers swimming past your boat in the bay. We are a friendly self-help club with a race program, fun social events, a clubhouse and patio for hanging out and BBQs. We are off the grid and there is no traffic nearby.
